first.rationale: Onboarding simplification directly addresses the concurrent completion and activation declines, with prior evidence of durable activation lift. A guarded test protects qualified-revenue quality while measuring downstream conversion. Promotional pricing is highly consequential given competitor pressure, but its inherited evidence does not yet establish sustainable qualified revenue or retention, so it requires verification before displacing the activation-focused action.

final.rationale: Run a guarded SMB self-serve onboarding-simplification experiment this week. It directly targets both deteriorating onboarding completion and activation, while the verified SMB result showed activation +9% and qualified revenue +4%, with only a -1% 30-day retention change. Measure qualified revenue and retention alongside completion and activation before expansion. Do not use promotional pricing: its verified +18% qualified-revenue lift came with -12% 30-day retention and an explicit finding that it is not sustainable-growth strategy.
